root_cause.text: The `get_manuf_info()` function in the io_ti USB serial driver permits a heap overflow because it trusts a device-controlled size field for memory copying without validating it against the fixed size of the destination buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states the `Size` field is only validated against `TI_MAX_I2C_SIZE` and not the 10-byte buffer size, while the patch introduces a check ensuring `le16_to_cpu(rom_desc->Size)` equals `sizeof(struct edge_ti_manuf_descriptor)` before reading data.

vuln_statements.explanation: This memcpy call copies 'len' bytes (device-controlled) into info->manuf buffer without validating that len doesn't exceed the fixed buffer size, causing heap overflow when len > sizeof(info->manuf)
